$comment: Chapter 2 mission — The Silent River. Clouds block the optical camera for days; SAR sees through but stresses power, mass, and budget.
title: The Silent River
goal: See the flood through days of cloud and warn the river villages.

outcomeTiers.text: Rescue boats were staged before the water arrived.
Most unions along the river knew which way to run.
The river stayed silent on the maps. People guessed.

briefing.speaker: tanvir
briefing.text: The monsoon has parked itself over the delta. Days of full cloud cover. The visible camera is useless — it will photograph the tops of clouds, not the flood.

briefing.speaker: kabir
briefing.text: There is a way to see through cloud: radar. Synthetic Aperture Radar — SAR. It lights the ground with its own signal and listens.

briefing.speaker: sharmin
briefing.text: I have read about SAR. It eats power for breakfast and costs more than my whole year's budget line.

briefing.speaker: kabir
briefing.text: Which is why we also bought bigger buses. Twenty-seven units, three payload slots, and panels to feed them.

briefing.speaker: tanvir
briefing.text: Thermal infrared still works at night and reads the flood's heat signature. SAR works in daylight through anything. Choose your weapons.

briefing.speaker: alam
briefing.text: The river villages need warning before the second crest. You have ten days. Again.
